title: Kernel selector v2: feature flag/kill switch + per-model-family overrides (with config validation)
author: Benji Okafor
description: Context: selector v2 is ready for broader integration, but we need safe rollout controls and a deterministic way to pin behavior during canaries and customer escalations. This PR adds (1) feature-flag gating (global + scoped), (2) an emergency kill switch, (3) per-model-family overrides (including a v1-forced mode and per-family kernel pins), and (4) strict config validation so bad configs fail fast at startup rather than silently falling back. Summary of behavior: Selector version decision is now a first-class part of runtime config. A request’s final selection path is determined by precedence: kill switch > explicit per-family override > cohort enablement (tier/region) > default selector version. If selector v2 is chosen but the registry is missing an applicable entry (unknown family / missing GPU normalization / seq bucket mismatch), we fall back to the safe kernel set and emit a structured event (and optionally can fall back to selector v1 depending on override). Overrides are designed for: (a) targeted mitigation (pin a family/GPU to known-good kernel), (b) controlled experiments (enable v2 only for specific families), and (c) Dedicated customer requests to pin behavior for evaluation. Config/flags added: - runtime.kernel_selector.version_default: v1|v2 (default remains v1 in this PR) - runtime.kernel_selector.v2.enabled: bool (gates v2 availability globally) - runtime.kernel_selector.v2.enable_scopes: list of scopes (region/tier) used by release tooling - runtime.kernel_selector.kill_switch: bool (hard-disable v2; forces v1 selection path) - runtime.kernel_selector.overrides_by_model_family: map (model_family -> override struct) supporting: selector_version (v1|v2), force_safe_kernels (bool), pinned_kernel_ids_by_gpu (map gpu_class -> kernel_id), and allow_v1_fallback_on_miss (bool). Validation: We validate at startup: unknown selector versions, unknown model family keys (unless allow_unknown_families is explicitly set), duplicate/ambiguous GPU classes, and pinned kernel IDs that don’t exist in the loaded registry. We also validate override precedence rules (e.g., pinned_kernel_ids_by_gpu requires selector_version=v2 and registry_loaded=true). Failures are fatal by default; can be configured to warn-only for local/dev. Observability hooks: when an override is applied we annotate the selection context with override_source=kill_switch|family_override|scope_enablement|default and override_action=force_v1|pin_kernel|force_safe|none (labels are bucketed per telemetry standards; detailed per-request info stays in traces only when sampling is enabled). Rollout notes: This does not flip v2 on by default. It unblocks the staged rollout PRs by giving Release Eng/SRE a kill switch and allowing targeted mitigation without redeploying binaries. Testing: unit tests around precedence + validation, plus a small integration test that loads a sample registry and applies overrides for Llama-family and Mistral-family across L4/A10. Linked: ENG-3931. Follow-ups: wire these fields into the Console rollout UI (PM-611) and update runbook with concrete examples once we merge.
commits: runtime/config: add kernel_selector section schema + defaults
runtime/flags: introduce selector v2 enablement + kill switch wiring
runtime/selector: apply override/precedence logic before registry lookup
runtime/config_validation: validate overrides against registry + known GPU classes
tests: add precedence matrix tests + bad-config startup tests
docs(internal): add inline comments on override precedence + examples
changed_files: deploy/values/runtime-defaults.yaml (keeps v1 default; v2 disabled by default)
snippet:
Example config:

runtime:
  kernel_selector:
    version_default: v1
    v2:
      enabled: true
      enable_scopes:
        - tier: hosted
          region: us-east-1
          percent: 5
    kill_switch: false
    overrides_by_model_family:
      llama:
        selector_version: v2
        allow_v1_fallback_on_miss: true
      mistral:
        selector_version: v1
        force_safe_kernels: true
      qwen:
        selector_version: v2
        pinned_kernel_ids_by_gpu:
          l4: attn_flash_v3_prefill
          a10: attn_xformers_decode_safe

Precedence (highest first): kill_switch -> family override -> scoped enablement -> version_default
review_conversation: Grace Kim: Can we clarify precedence between pinned kernel vs force_safe_kernels? Also want to ensure pinned kernels are only allowed when selector_version=v2.

Benji Okafor (author): Updated validation: pinned_kernel_ids_by_gpu now requires selector_version=v2. Precedence within family override is: force_safe_kernels wins over pinned kernel (explicitly documented + tests).
Omar El-Sayed: Where is the cohort % applied? I want to make sure it’s deterministic per-request (same customer gets same behavior) and doesn’t depend on process RNG.
Benji Okafor (author): Cohort hashing uses (org_id, model_family, region) stable hash -> bucket [0..99]. No RNG. Added unit test to assert stability across runs.
Allison Grant: Telemetry labels: please ensure we don’t emit raw kernel_id as a metric label. Traces are fine. Also avoid high-cardinality model names.

Benji Okafor (author): Metrics only include kernel_id_bucket (from registry) + model_family (bounded set) + gpu_class + selector_version + override_source. Raw kernel_id is in trace annotation under sampling. Added a guard that rejects configs that would create unbounded family keys unless allow_unknown_families is set.
Connor O'Brien: For emergency rollback I need an operator-friendly knob that does not require pushing a new config file to every region. Can kill_switch be wired to an env var too?

Benji Okafor (author): Yes. kill_switch can be set via env RUNTIME_KERNEL_SELECTOR_KILL_SWITCH=true which overrides config (documented in code comment). Config still wins in local/dev unless env is set.
Kira Thompson: Please add a short example to inline docs for Dedicated: pin selector_version=v1 for a family and force safe kernels while investigating NaNs.
Benji Okafor (author): Added inline example block and a brief note pointing to the upcoming runbook PR (ENG-3935 follow-up).
Grace Kim: One more: what happens if registry isn’t loaded but selector_version=v2 is forced by override?
Benji Okafor (author): Validation fails fast in prod (fatal). In dev, warn-only if runtime.config.validation_mode=warn. Added explicit error message including family + reason.
release_notes: Added runtime config + flags for kernel selector v2 staged rollout (scoped enablement, kill switch).
Added per-model-family override support (force v1/v2, force safe kernels, optional per-GPU kernel pin).
Added startup validation to prevent invalid override configs and mismatched registry references.
